## Installation

1. Download and install [GTA III The Definitive Edition Fusion Mod](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#gta3de), or the required x64 version of the [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for GTA III The Definitive Edition](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/gta3de/GTA3DE.XboxRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` and `.ini` files into the `scripts` folder of `Gameface\Binaries\Win64`.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- The drops are drawn in the middle of the frame of the game, so the HUD of the Definitive Edition stays readable behind them.
- The ini is watched while the game runs, so its settings can be changed and tested without restarting.
